findings.title: Gestation as enclosure, settling, and churn
findings.claim: The focus's ripe falling is placed inside a local sequence of enclosure, pregnancy, labor, disturbance, and bodily settling, so release appears as controlled provision after gestational pressure.
findings.mechanism: The barrier and inward-bearing occurrences contact labor and the focus fall, while the sequel's settling contact closes the movement; these independent relations make the fall a gestationally framed release rather than an isolated event.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus becomes legible as a transition from enclosed and agitated life toward a settled, nourishing outcome.
findings.containment: The relation is local to the supplied pericope; it does not make the dates a fetus, make the palm literally pregnant, or replace the ordinary instruction to shake the palm for ripe dates.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted, while several contacts are multi-step semantic inferences; the packet supplies their carriers, triggers, and limits.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Advanced pregnancy idiom
branch_activations.carrier: The barrier occurrence in 19:17 carries an enclosing spatial image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The bearing and labor occurrences in 19:22-23 supply gestational content.
branch_activations.activation: The enclosure image contacts the pregnancy and labor sequence, and the focus fruit-release returns that contact through the fall word.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The palm instruction participates in a locally enclosed gestational scene whose release is directed toward nourishment.
branch_activations.boundary: 19:17 supplies an enclosure carrier, not a local assertion that the word حجاب itself means advanced pregnancy.

branch_activations.facet_statement: pregnancy and inward bearing
branch_activations.carrier: The carrying occurrence in 19:22 supplies inward bearing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus trunk and fresh moist fruit provide an external fruit-bearing counterpart.
branch_activations.activation: Inward bearing meets the palm's trunk-to-fruit relation, so pregnancy and tree yield explain one another at the focus.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The dates become the tree-side release of an image that has already carried life inward.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation does not erase the ordinary meaning of carrying a child or turn the palm into a literal womb.

branch_activations.boundary: The dates are not identified with a child and the ordinary fruit-fall reading remains intact.

findings.containment: This remains a local harvest reading; it does not make the worker the independent producer of the fruit or suppress the command's consoling setting.

epistemic.reason: The trusted nomination is directly supported by the focus forms, the 19:23 palm context, and the 19:26 eating continuation.
